title: Mastery Challenge: Expectation, Poker Distributions & Dice Mechanics

questions.promptText: What is the constant sum of the numbers on opposite faces of any standard 6-sided die?
questions.explanation: On any standard die, opposite faces are paired to always sum to 7 ($1+6 = 2+5 = 3+4 = 7$).

questions.promptText: In the game of Craps, what is the term for rolling a total of 2 with two 1s on a pair of dice?
questions.explanation: Rolling a pair of 1s is traditionally termed "snake eyes", occurring with probability $1/36$.

questions.promptText: A raffle ticket costs $\text{P}20$. There are 500 tickets sold and a single grand prize of $\text{P}8,000$. What is the mathematical expectation of buying one ticket?
questions.explanation:
Expected gross winnings $= \text{P}8,000 \times \frac{1}{500} = \text{P}16$. Net expectation $= \text{P}16 - \text{P}20 = -\text{P}4$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $\frac{8000}{500} - 20 = 16 - 20 = -4$.

questions.promptText: Which historical Roman ruler is represented by the King of Diamonds in a standard card deck?
questions.explanation: King of Diamonds depicts Julius Caesar; Hearts depicts Charlemagne; Clubs depicts Alexander the Great; Spades depicts King David.

questions.promptText: How many distinct Royal Flush hands can be formed from a standard 52-card deck?
questions.explanation: There are exactly 4 suits, and each suit has only 1 combination of A-K-Q-J-10. Hence, there are exactly 4 Royal Flushes out of 2,598,960 total hands.

questions.promptText: In rolling two standard dice simultaneously, which sum has the highest probability of occurring?
questions.explanation: A sum of 7 can be formed in 6 ways: $(1,6), (2,5), (3,4), (4,3), (5,2), (6,1)$, giving the peak probability of $6/36 = 1/6$.

questions.promptText: How many 5-card Full House hands (three of a kind and a pair) exist in a 52-card deck?
questions.explanation:
Full House combinations $= {}_{13} C_1 \times {}_4 C_3 \times {}_{12} C_1 \times {}_4 C_2 = 13 \times 4 \times 12 \times 6 = 3,744$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $13 \times 4 \times 12 \times 6 = 3744$.

questions.promptText: A player rolls a fair die. If a 6 turns up, the player wins $\text{P}120$; otherwise, the player loses $\text{P}30$. What is the mathematical expectation?
Which ancient civilization is credited with first using dice?
questions.explanation: Historical records show that dice were first used and developed by the Chinese for gambling and games of chance.

questions.promptText: What is the total number of distinct 5-card hands that can be dealt from a standard 52-card deck?
In a card deck, what does the presence of 12 face cards symbolize in the calendar metaphor?
questions.explanation: In standard playing card symbolism: 52 cards = 52 weeks, 4 suits = 4 seasons, and 12 face cards = 12 months in a year.

questions.promptText: What is the expected frequency of being dealt a Royal Flush in 5-card poker?
questions.explanation: Expected frequency $= \frac{2,598,960}{4} = 649,740$ hands per Royal Flush.

questions.promptText: If the sum of two standard dice is rolled, what is the probability that the sum is an EVEN number?
questions.explanation: There are 18 even sum outcomes and 18 odd sum outcomes out of 36. Probability $= 18/36 = 1/2$.

questions.promptText: How many 5-card Four-of-a-Kind hands exist in poker?
questions.explanation:
Four of a kind: ${}_{13} C_1 \times {}_4 C_4 \times {}_{48} C_1 = 13 \times 1 \times 48 = 624$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $13 \times 48 = 624$.

questions.promptText: In European Roulette, a single zero wheel has 37 slots (0 to 36). A single number bet pays 35 to 1. What is the house edge (negative expectation per unit bet)?
questions.explanation: $E[X] = 35\left(\frac{1}{37}\right) - 1\left(\frac{36}{37}\right) = -\frac{1}{37} \approx -0.0270 \implies 2.70\%$ house edge.

questions.promptText: If a die is placed on a table such that the number on top is 5, what number is facing directly down against the tabletop?
questions.explanation: Opposite faces sum to 7. Since the top face is 5, the bottom face is $7 - 5 = 2$.

questions.promptText: How many 5-card Straight Flush hands (excluding Royal Flush) exist in poker?
questions.explanation: There are 10 straights per suit $\times 4$ suits $= 40$ total straight flushes. Subtracting the 4 Royal Flushes leaves $40 - 4 = 36$ straight flushes.

questions.promptText: What is the King of Spades traditionally named after?
questions.explanation: King of Spades is attributed to King David of biblical Israel.

questions.promptText: What is the probability of rolling a sum of either 2 or 12 on two dice?

A life insurance company charges an annual premium of $\text{P}2,500$ for a $\text{P}200,000$ policy. If the probability that the policyholder survives the year is $0.99$, what is the company's expected profit per policy?
questions.explanation:
$E[X] = \text{Premium} - \text{Expected Claim} = 2,500 - (200,000 \times 0.01) = 2,500 - 2,000 = \text{P}500$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $2500 - 200000(0.01) = 500$.

questions.promptText: What percentage of all possible 5-card poker hands contain NO pair, straight, flush, or other scoring combination (High Card only)?
questions.explanation: High card / no pair occurs in $1,302,540$ hands out of $2,598,960$, which represents $\approx 50.1177\% \approx 50.12\%$.

questions.promptText: If two standard dice are rolled, what is the probability that the sum is greater than 9?
questions.explanation: Sums > 9 are 10 (3 ways), 11 (2 ways), 12 (1 way). Total favorable $= 3 + 2 + 1 = 6$ ways. $P = 6/36 = 1/6$.
